Name: (CP) Pierre sells seasonal seeds year-round after Community Center completion
Author: HeadInTheCloudsMods
Description:
Hey all! Basically was lurking around the SDV discord, and someone asked if there was a mod where all seeds were sold year-round after community center completion. There didn't seem to be any, so here it is! Enjoy <3









SPOILERS:
After community center completion, the player will get a letter from the Junimos with Pierre's Stocklist (a vanilla item, usually only available at Qi's Gem Shop), which can be gifted to Pierre to unlock year-round seeds!

Manifest.Name: Coummunity Center Seeds™
Manifest.Description: Pierre sells seasonal seeds year-round after Community Center completion.
Manifest.Author: HeadInTheClouds
